info.title: Node.js script to expand ranges to array

diffs.patch:
Index: package.json
===================================================================
--- package.json	
+++ package.json	
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+{
+  "name": "range-expander",
+  "version": "1.0.0",
+  "description": "Expand ranges like \"1-10\" or \"a-z\" into an array of values",
+  "type": "module",
+  "main": "./src/expandRange.js",
+  "bin": {
+    "expand-range": "./bin/cli.js"
+  },
+  "scripts": {
+    "test": "node --test",
+    "lint": "node --check src/expandRange.js && node --check bin/cli.js"
+  },
+  "engines": {
+    "node": ">=18"
+  },
+  "license": "MIT"
+}

parts.text:
Done. Project set up at `/work`:

- `src/expandRange.js` — `expandRange("1-10")` → numbers, `expandRange("a-z")` → letters. Handles descending, negatives, and whitespace; validates input.
- `bin/cli.js` — CLI (`npm link` then `expand-range 1-10 a-z`, or `node bin/cli.js`).
- `test/expandRange.test.js` — 9 tests via built-in `node:test` (all passing).
- `package.json` — ESM, `npm test` / `npm run lint` scripts, no dependencies.

Notes: numeric ranges return numbers, letter ranges return strings; mixed-case (`a-Z`) is rejected. Say the word if you'd prefer everything returned as strings or the CLI to support comma lists.
